thread:
maria: small design sync: thinking about the prompt-sets regression diff list 1UX problem1. current rows feel visually noisy when you have 20+ diffs. attaching a quick sketch in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/yyy

sam: yes this. the eye jumps around. suggestion: introduce a subtle background banding by row group (light tint) so you can scan vertical alignment easier, and reduce heavy separators.

devin: +1 banding. also add a compact mode control in header (three dots menu) so reviewers can switch density per session. default should respect user's previously saved preference.

jordan: copy tweak for approval modal: current title "Approve changes" -> prefer "Approve selected revisions". also the confirm button text should say "Approve 12 revisions" when multiple selected to reduce ambiguity.

alex: accessibility: contrast issue again with the diff-highlight yellow on dark-mode cards. can we pick a more accessible shade (#FFD966 on light bg, #B88600 on dark bg) and ensure highlight has 3:1 contrast ratio with surrounding text? Also need focus indicators for inline action buttons (diff comment, resolve).

maria: good catch. also thinking about the regression heatmap thumbnail in the right rail. it currently has tiny tappable targets. increase target size to 44px and add aria-labels like "Open regression timeline".

sam: behavior nit: when you click a diff row it opens details panel but doesn't move keyboard focus into the panel. keyboard users lose context. propose on open: move focus to panel heading and trap focus until closed.

devin: UX product question: do we want per-diff "mark as wont-fix"? i worry about proliferation of statuses. maybe keep only "Accepted", "Investigate", "Reject" to simplify filters.

jordan: undo toast for bulk changes should include action link and keyboard shortcut hint: "Undo (z)". small accessibility win. also animation duration: reduce from 400ms to 160ms for reduced-motion users.

alex: aria-live recommendation: when bulk approval completes, announce "12 revisions approved" via polite live region. For errors, use assertive region.

maria: visual suggestion: for small diffs (1-2 tokens) the highlight looks like a dot. maybe render inline context (2 words before/after) and only show full diff on hover/focus. reduces visual clutter.

sam: CSS sketch for banding + focus:
```css
.diff-row { background: var(--bg); border-bottom: 0; padding: 12px 16px; }
.diff-row.group-alt { background: rgba(16,24,32,0.02); }
.diff-row:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26,115,232,0.12); outline: none; }
```

maria: action items: 1) maria to update figma with banding and compact mode control 2) alex to run contrast checks and add aria notes 3) devin to write a short PR spec for behavior changes (focus movement + undo toast) 4) sam to prototype keyboard focus ring. i'll post mock images here after update.

aria-bot: ticket UX-679 created: "regression-diff list density + a11y improvements" assigned to @maria, labels: design, accessibility, product.

alex: taking the contrast checklist. will post scan results here when done.

maria: thanks team. will try to keep the figma changes minimal so eng can review quickly. if any objections to the compact toggle placement, call it out now. :slightly_smiling_face:
